summary: Each budget line can record WHY its amount is what it is: amount_basis (contract, historical_forecast, board_project, discretionary, assessment, transfer), the arithmetic in words, the vendor contract and library document behind it, and needs_review with a note. A line whose amount changes after its basis was recorded is marked needs_review. No amount, month, budget, GL account or balance changes; approved budgets stay locked.

preflight.name: budget_line_items has none of the basis columns yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'budget_line_items' AND column_name IN ('amount_basis', 'amount_calc', 'vendor_contract_id', 'source_document_id', 'needs_review', 'review_note')

preflight.name: the migration 462 lock trigger is on budget_line_items
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_budget_line_items_lock_guard' AND NOT tgisinternal

preflight.name: vendor_contracts and library_documents exist for the references
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('vendor_contracts', 'library_documents')

expected_changes: budget_line_items: six new columns (amount_basis, amount_calc, vendor_contract_id, source_document_id, needs_review default false, review_note), a CHECK on amount_basis, two references with ON DELETE SET NULL and their indexes.
budget_line_items: a trigger marks a line needs_review when its annual amount changes and its basis is not rewritten in the same update.
No budget line amount, month, note or status changes; no budget header, GL, journal entry or contract changes. The migration 462 lock still blocks approved budgets.

verify.name: all six basis columns exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'budget_line_items' AND column_name IN ('amount_basis', 'amount_calc', 'vendor_contract_id', 'source_document_id', 'needs_review', 'review_note')

verify.name: no existing line was flagged or given a basis
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM budget_line_items WHERE amount_basis IS NOT NULL OR needs_review

verify.name: amount_basis allows exactly the six bases
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'budget_line_items_amount_basis_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%contract%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%historical_forecast%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%board_project%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%discretionary%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%assessment%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%transfer%'

verify.name: the migration 462 lock trigger is still on budget_line_items
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgname = 'trg_budget_line_items_lock_guard' AND NOT tgisinternal
